title: Slim interaction proxy PRD: tiered-quality hosted endpoint (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) & gated launch checklist
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary: Build and launch a lightweight 'interaction proxy' hosted endpoint that exposes a single cohesive surface for low-latency chat/completions plus optional embedding + rerank stages. The goal is a compact integration path for customers who want a cost-conscious fast lane for standard conversational flows while preserving an upgrade path to higher-quality lanes (balanced/high) without client changes.

Rationale: Many customers request a single endpoint they can call from the product that covers simple chat use cases and, when needed, runs an inexpensive embedding + rerank pass to improve precision for retrieval-augmented flows. Instead of multiple endpoints, this proxy offers a tiered-quality model configuration and built-in routing/fallbacks to reduce integration complexity and improve unit economics.

Scope (in):
- Single hosted endpoint: POST /v1/interaction-proxy with fields for mode: chat|complete and optional retrieval: {embedding: boolean, rerank: boolean}.
- Tiered quality lanes: quick (small model, quantized, aggressive batching), balanced (mid-size), high (larger model or multi-stage with rerank).
- Optional embedding generation (tenant-scoped) and in-proxy rerank stage that accepts up to N candidate documents and returns the top K ordered by score.
- Canary and gradual rollout controls via Console (traffic slicing by tenant/region).
- Telemetry: token-level cost breakdown, per-model latency P50/P95, rerank precision, embedding QPS, fallback counts.

Out of scope (for this ticket):
- Dedicated or Private runtime packaging.
- Long-context (>32k) specialized kernels.
- Multi-modal (images/audio) inputs.

Non-functional requirements:
- Quick lane p50 latency <= 90ms for 1-128 token responses at baseline load.
- Canary lane cost per 1k tokens < 60% of balanced lane.
- End-to-end rerank pass < 300ms median for <= 10 candidates.
- No quality regression >1% on CI eval suites for balanced lane compared to current hosted baseline.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Kapoor), Eng Leads (Ethan Kim, Priya Desai), Design (Marco Liu), SRE (Lena Ortiz), Security/Compliance (Carlos Mendes), Solutions Eng (Rory Patel).

Telemetry & success metrics:
- Adoption: 50 customers integrate within first quarter post-launch.
- Cost: 20% reduction in per-interaction token cost for quick lane vs standard hosted endpoint on comparable traffic patterns.
- Latency: maintain latency SLOs above.
- Quality: no more than 1% drop in eval-based relevance for balanced lane.

Rollout plan (high level):
1) Internal alpha with dev tenants and smoke tests.
2) Canary with 5% traffic, monitoring dashboards for correctness and cost.
3) Progressive ramp 5->25->100% with automated rollback triggers.

Backstop policies: automatic fallback to balanced lane on increased error rate or cost anomalies. Manual rollback runbook for customers impacted.

Documentation: public PRD (link in 'links'), quickstart SDK snippet for Node/Python, Console doc for canary controls and cost preview.
acceptance_criteria: API contract published: /v1/interaction-proxy schema and examples in API spec (Node/Python).
Quick lane meets p50 latency <= 90ms under benchmark profile (1-128 tokens).
Rerank stage median latency <= 300ms for up to 10 candidates in production canary.
Cost estimate validated: quick lane shows >=20% cost reduction vs standard hosted endpoint on synthetic traffic.
Behavioral regression tests pass: balanced lane quality delta <= 1% vs current baseline across 6 eval suites (conversational, FAQ, retrieval).
Console controls available: canary slices, lane overrides, per-tenant cost preview and rollout toggles.
Observability: dashboards created (latency, cost, rerank precision, fallback rate) and alerting thresholds defined and tested.
Security review completed and KMS encryption for embeddings at rest enabled where tenant-configured.
SDK and docs: 2 quickstart samples (chat and retrieval+ranks) and endpoint usage guide published.
Launch checklist items marked done and post-launch monitoring window staffed by SRE and Solutions Eng for 72 hours.
launch_checklist: Finalize API schema and open API spec merged to main: GH PR # (link in links).
Performance bench results published and annotated in docbench dashboard.
Create Console feature flag for canary and lane selection; verify permission gating.
Run security review: threat model and KMS integration signoff.
Create billing SKU and verify cost meter for quick/balanced/high lanes.
Prepare SDK snippets and in-repo examples for node/python; publish to docs site.
Create dashboards: interaction-proxy latency (p50/p95), cost per 1k tokens, rerank precision, fallback counts.
Define alerting: latency spike, error rate >1%, cost anomaly +20% vs baseline; link alert runbook.
Execute canary with dev tenants (alpha) for at least 48 hours; capture metrics and iterate.
Open customer communication: draft launch email, changelog entry, and migration notes for existing endpoints.
On-call rotation scheduled for 72-hour post-launch window with SRE + Solutions Eng.
Legal & Compliance checklist completed (DPA/KMS notes) for tenants in EU and US regions.
Prepare rollback artifacts: automated circuit-breaker, config to remap tenant to balanced lane or previous endpoint.
Signoffs: PM, Eng Lead, Design, Security, SRE (verbal + PR approvals recorded in comments).
notes: Trade-offs: we prioritize a fast integration surface over exposing every lane detail. Quick lane uses higher batching/quantization which may slightly reduce best-effort quality; balanced lane is recommended for users who care about deterministic relevance. We intentionally avoid packaging for Private in this ticket to reduce scope and surface risk for launch.
